name: Huda Sha'arawi
shortBio: Egyptian feminist philosopher, constitutionalist organizer, and founder of the Egyptian Feminist Union who articulated an anti-colonial nationalist ethics linking women's civil rights, educational parity, and national sovereignty.
centralQuestion: How do anti-colonial national liberation and reform of Islamic and civic family law mutually condition women's public citizenship?

keyWorks.title: Harem Years: The Memoirs of an Egyptian Feminist
keyWorks.description: Autobiographical and socio-political account documenting Egyptian women's anti-colonial mobilization and emergence into public civic life.
